summary: Something may look convincing right up until you ask the question nobody has given you a straight answer to yet.
body: Something may look convincing right up until you ask the question nobody has given you a straight answer to yet. When the Sun squares Neptune, confidence and projection blur together, making a person, promise, or plan easier to believe before the missing details become obvious. If the numbers keep moving, the explanation changes, or you are being asked to trust what nobody will put in writing, pay attention. Inspiration is not the problem. Building your next move on information that keeps dissolving is.
